criteria: Non-playable present-day characters important to Archon/Story/World quests, regional politics or major lore.
notes: Generated from the discovery research pass on 2026-10-11 and maintained by hand afterwards. Status is computed by tools/check_coverage.py --sync.

items.name: The Tsaritsa
items.notes: Cryo Archon of Snezhnaya; wiki page title 'Anastasya'. Added by hand (dedupe dropped npc.anastasya).

items.name: Paimon
items.notes: The Traveler's companion and guide. Added by hand.

items.name: Asmoday
items.notes: Ruler of Space, the 'Sustainer of Heavenly Principles' from the prologue (wiki page 'Sustainer of Heavenly Principles' redirects here). Owns the Temple of Space. Missing from Celestia since the Cataclysm; has defected and aligned with the Traveler's sibling/Abyss Order.

items.name: Capitano
items.notes: Il Capitano ('The Captain'), personal name Thrain, First of the Fatui Harbingers. Khaenri'ahn commander cursed with immortality by Ronova; central to the Natlan Archon Quest and counted among the Heroes of Natlan. Wiki lists him as a Quest NPC (not playable) as of the current wiki. The 5.0 first in-game appearance is assumed. | 'The Captain', 1st Harbinger; Khaenri'ahn knight Thrain, under a curse of immortality from Ronova. Incapacitated, his life force merged with Yohualtecuhtin (5.x), but the Tsaritsa keeps his seat. Mentor of Danica. Not playable as of 7.1. | Il Capitano, real name Thrain; Khaenri'ahn knight-commander, First Harbinger; merged his existence with Yohualtecuhtin, body dormant on the Throne of the Primal Fire. Not playable. Likely shared with Fatui scope.

items.name: Dainsleif
items.notes: NOT playable as of 7.1 (wiki infobox type=Upcoming). Former captain of Khaenri'ah's Royal Guard (Twilight Sword), cursed with immortality; Vedrfolnir's younger brother. Involved in Ronova's defeat in 7.1 AQ, then granted audience with the Tsaritsa. Reclassify to character if released later.

items.name: Dottore
items.notes: 'The Doctor', 2nd Harbinger, Zandik, born in Sumeru (wiki region Sumeru). Refused a recall order and tried to seize the power of the Three Moons. Died in Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana (Luna VII/6.6). Status: deceased.

items.name: Dvalin
items.notes: Stormterror, the Anemo Dragon of the Seven Sovereigns and Dragon of the East of the Four Winds. A major figure in the Mondstadt Archon Quest (Prologue). | Anemo dragon, successor to the original Anemo Sovereign; slew Durin in the Cataclysm. Likely also in Mondstadt scope.

items.name: Focalors
items.notes: Last Hydro Archon, the divine half separate from Furina (Furina is playable: character.furina). Executed herself via the Oratrice in The Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur (4.2). Typed npc rather than historical because she acts in the present-day story.

items.name: Pantalone
items.notes: 'Regrator', 9th Harbinger, Feofan Sergeyevich Veksel; president of Northland Bank. In-game intro in the Purana quest (6.6). Featured in 7.1 (Seals of Life vault).

items.name: Pierro
items.notes: 'The Jester', Director of the Fatui; personal name Eftirvit. Khaenri'ahn royal mage and Sinner, former Vice-President of the Universitas Magistrorum. Summoned Paimon from Celestia; Hroptatyr summoned the Traveler's sibling at the same time. Gained a new Delusion in 7.1. Unclear whether he holds the 10th seat. | The Jester, real name Eftirvit; Director of the Fatui; former Khaenri'ahn royal mage and Vice-President of the Universitas Magistrorum; mortally wounded Ronova with the Eye of the Fatui. Likely shared with Fatui scope.

items.name: Pulcinella
items.notes: 'The Rooster', 5th Harbinger, Mirko Radovidovich Veleshek. A long-lived Domovoy; Mayor of Snezhnograd and Glupov and Speaker of the Snezhnograd Veche; an organizer of Project Stuzha. First in-game appearance in 7.0.

items.name: Rhinedottir
items.notes: 'Gold', one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, Hexenzirkel 'R', creator of Albedo and Durin. The wiki lists her as Ruler of Life among the Four Shades, alive and merged with Naberius. She overlaps with the cosmology/Khaenri'ah scopes, so dedupe there. | 'Gold', Hexenzirkel 'R' (Sage-Witch), one of the Five Sinners. Became Ruler of Life by consuming Naberius' heart. Collaborated with Ronova; met the Tsaritsa in 7.1. Assigned here once; also Khaenri'ah/Hexenzirkel. | 'Gold', Hexenzirkel 'R', one of the Five Sinners, Art of Khemia alchemist, creator of Albedo and Durin. Devoured Naberius and is now the de facto Ruler of Life among the Four Shades (appeared as Naberius' proxy). Uses Sebas as intermediary.

items.name: Ronova
items.notes: Ruler of Death among the Four Shades. Cursed Capitano, and Mavuika could wield her power. Died in Black Feathers Scattered at Parting (7.1). Probably owned by the cosmology/shades scope; dedupe. First-appearance version not verified. | Ruler of Death of the Four Shades and Arbiter of the Heavenly Principles; main antagonist of Chapter VII (Curse of Death). Celestia revoked her authority in 7.1; she was crushed by Pierro, then fused the Eitr with the Nail above the Cryo Dragon's corpse, threatening Holy Soil. Wiki: died in Black Feathers Scattered at Parting. Overlaps cosmology.shades. | Ruler of Death, Arbiter of the Heavenly Principles. Cast the Curse of Immortality on Khaenri'ahns; instructed creation of the Night Kingdom. Intervened against Project Mistilteinn; authority recalled by Celestia after using the Curse of Death; mortally wounded by Pierro via the Eye of the Fatui and died (

items.name: Signora
items.notes: 'The Fair Lady', 8th Harbinger, Rosalyne-Kruzchka Lohefalter; Mondstadt-born Crimson Witch of Flames. Died in Duel Before the Throne (2.1). Odette's mentor; her tomb is in Snezhnaya.

items.name: Traveler's Sibling
items.notes: Aether/Lumine (opposite of player's choice). Prince/Princess of the Abyss Order; named heir of Khaenri'ah by Irmin. Was influenced by Istaroth to leave Khaenri'ah; used the Loom of Fate in the Night Kingdom to reweave Khaenri'ah's ley lines (Haden claims Khaenri'ah revived). Asmoday has defected to their side.

items.name: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night
items.notes: Lord of the Crossroads, a former Angel who created and rules the Night Kingdom and guided Natlan's ancient tribes. Awakened during the 5.1 Archon Quest (version assumed). Could be classed as cosmology; typed npc as a present-day deity.

items.name: Ajaw
items.notes: K'uhul Ajaw (Aj Imuch' Paxlaq Lahun), the self-proclaimed Almighty Dragonlord. One of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords and Kinich's companion; first appears in Natlan! A New Adventure.

items.name: Aksinya
items.notes: Hyperborean survivor and the Belyi Tsar's adopted daughter and 'Court Jester'; secret head of the Hvergelmir institute. Central to the 7.0 world quests (Her Palace Collapses Into the Blizzard, etc.).

items.name: Alice
items.notes: Founder of the Hexenzirkel ('A'), Klee's mother, author of the Teyvat Travel Guide; appeared in person in Nod-Krai (6.x) quests such as 'Ripples That Will Never Reach'. | Hexenzirkel 'A' (Merry-Witch) and founder; Klee's mother; author of the Teyvat Travel Guide. Also Mondstadt. First in-game appearance in Ripples That Will Never Reach (Luna III).

items.name: Andrius
items.notes: Boreas/Andrius, the Wolf of the North among the Four Winds; a Snezhnayan wolf god blessed by Koitar in Nod-Krai. Also a weekly boss (page 'Andrius'). Lupical lore ties to Razor.

items.name: Apep
items.notes: Dendro Dragon Sovereign, still alive today. Appears in the 3.6 Archon interlude and in 6.6 Act IX. Could also be filed as creature/dragons or cosmology/dragons. | Dendro Sovereign, alive; ruled Sumeru before the Heavenly Principles; corrupted by forbidden knowledge (Heart of Oasis).

items.name: Azar
items.notes: Former Grand Sage and Rtawahist Sage, the main antagonist of the Sumeru Archon Quest. Deposed afterwards.

items.name: Azhdaha
items.notes: Geo Dragon of the Seven Sovereigns, sealed by Morax under the Dragon-Queller and The Chasm. Zhongli's Story Quest ('No Mere Stone') and a weekly boss. | Geo (Earth) Dragon sovereign; incapacitated/re-sealed after 'Amidst Chaos, the Rock Is Unmoved'.

items.name: Danica
items.notes: Danica Postelnitskaya, head maid of Zapolyarny Palace and the Tsaritsa's confidante; former mercenary and Capitano's protegee. Debuted in the 'Sudden Snow' trailer.

items.name: Dunyarzad
items.notes: Dunyarzad Homayani, follower of Kusanali whose body Nahida's consciousness travelled in. Appears in Chapter III, Dehya's story quest and Act IX.

items.name: Heryshaf
items.notes: Goat King, leader of King Deshret's Seven Pillars, confined in Aaru. Key figure in the 6.6 Acts IX-X.

items.name: Hroptatyr
items.notes: 'The Wise', President of the Universitas Magistrorum, Chief Royal Mage, favored of the 'Four Pillars of Khaenri'ah'; resented by Pierro. Status unclear; appeared in 6.1 (Luna II) content.

items.name: Istaroth
items.notes: Ruler of Time; aka Kairos, Tokoyo Ookami (Enkanomiya). Assisted Venti, Zibai, Makoto, Aberaku; nudged the sibling to leave Khaenri'ah during the Cataclysm. Alive.

items.name: Jeht
items.notes: Jeht Ufairah Hindi (formerly Tanit), central to the Golden Slumber, Dirge of Bilqis and Her Foes Rage series, and returns in the 6.6 Acts IX-X. Daughter of Jebrael.

items.name: Koitar
items.notes: Goddess of the Dawnstar, first Angel/Archangel of Celestia; rebelled with Anacharsis; stole part of Naberius' authority to create the Snowland Fae; memories restored, awaiting in Hyperborea. Overlaps Snezhnaya scope. | merged historical.koitar: Goddess of the Dawnstar, former Archangel of Celestia who ruled Hyperborea; wife of Anacharsis; blessed Boreas. Overlaps cosmology/celestia; dedupe.

items.name: Kujou Takayuki
items.notes: Tenryou Commissioner who colluded with the Fatui over Delusions. Removed after the Inazuma Archon Quest. Sara's adoptive father.

items.name: Liloupar
items.notes: Mother of the Jinn and Ormazd's wife, who destroyed Gurabad. Freed in the Golden Slumber and Dirge of Bilqis series and active in the 6.6 Acts IX-X. Present-day character.

items.name: Madame Ping
items.notes: Adeptus 'Streetward Rambler' living as an old woman at Yujing Terrace; gives the Serenitea Pot; Liyue AQ involvement.

items.name: Mitya
items.notes: Energy expert of the Royal Energy Commission and key researcher on Project Mistilteinn; bears Ronova's mark of death and has a sentient scarf. Wiki lists him as an UPCOMING playable character, not playable as of 7.1; re-prefix to character if he is released later.

items.name: Moon Carver
items.notes: Adeptus of Qingyun Peak (human alias Houzhang); appears in the Liyue Archon Quest.

items.name: Mountain Shaper
items.notes: Adeptus of Mt. Hulao (human alias Jiehu); appears in the Liyue Archon Quest. Cloud Retainer is playable as Xianyun, so she is not listed here.

items.name: Naberius
items.notes: Ruler of Life of the Four Shades; her power and consciousness are merged into Rhinedottir. Speaks in 7.1. May belong to cosmology.shades instead; dedupe. | Ruler of Life ('Mother of Life'). Heart devoured by Rhinedottir after the Cataclysm; consciousness persists inside Rhinedottir's body, disapproving. Revealed in 6.x (Luna VII updates).

items.name: Naphis
items.notes: Amurta Sage, the current Grand Sage, and Tighnari's master. Appears in the 6.6 Acts IX-X.

items.name: Nikita
items.notes: Current Starshyna (leader) of the Lightkeepers at Piramida.

items.name: Osial
items.notes: Overlord of the Vortex, sealed beneath Guyun Stone Forest. Freed by Childe in the Liyue Archon Quest (1.1) and resealed. Sealed rather than dead, so filed as npc.

items.name: Rerir
items.notes: Rächer of Solnari, Master of the Wild Hunt; former Eclipse Dynasty agent hunting Crimson Moon descendants; torn apart entering a moon gate seeking Tholindis. Major in Nod-Krai (6.0+).

items.name: Rotwang
items.notes: Rauthvangi / 'The Professor' / 'mad monk', a Khaenri'ahn exile at the Belyi Tsar's court who tried to open the False Sky. Killed by the Traveler and Illuga in The Last Night, the First Light (Luna IV). Version of first appearance uncertain.

items.name: Seamus Pegg
items.notes: Cardinal of Daybreak and Seneschal of the Church of Favonius, father of Jean and Barbara. Away on the expedition with Varka and appears in the 6.x Nod-Krai Archon Quests (e.g. 'An Elegy for Faded Moonlight', 'True Moon').

items.name: Surtalogi
items.notes: 'The Foul', Skirk's master, owner of the All-Devouring Narwhal; left Teyvat for the sea of stars (Cosmic Calamity).

items.name: Thoth
items.notes: Ibis King and Lord of Lies, one of the Seven Pillars and a former Moon Envoy. Wiki category: Luna II (6.1). Important in the Acts IX-X.

items.name: Valeriy
items.notes: Commander of the Armory Palace Special Assignments Battalion. Wiki lists him as an UPCOMING playable character, not playable as of 7.1.

items.name: Vedrfolnir
items.notes: 'The Visionary', Dainsleif's older brother, court seer; Abyss Order affiliated; suspected author of the Prophecy of Fontaine tablets. Present-day status unclear (treated as living).

items.name: Acatl
items.notes: Current chief of the Collective of Plenty (Teteocan). Version not verified.

items.name: Aedon
items.notes: Illuga's nightingale; once Solovei's companion.

items.name: Alkindi
items.notes: Current Spantamad Sage (Act IX). Luna VII = Version 6.6.

items.name: Amina
items.notes: Current chief of the People of the Springs (Meztli).

items.name: Ann
items.notes: Young Oceanid that Mary-Ann made from her memories. Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team (Ann of the Narzissenkreuz, 4.0).

items.name: Arama
items.notes: Aranara at the centre of the Aranyaka series.

items.name: Atea
items.notes: Candlekeeper of the People of the Springs (Home of the Hot Springs, 5.0). Died of Abyssal corrosion during the 5.x story.

items.name: Babel
items.notes: Babel Tanit, Tanit matriarch and antagonist of 'Her Foes Rage Like Great Waters...'. Dies in that quest.

items.name: Baishi
items.notes: Ningguang's secretary.

items.name: Baiwen
items.notes: One of Ningguang's three secretaries (Jade Chamber).

items.name: Baixiao
items.notes: Ningguang's secretary.

items.name: Baladhuri
items.notes: Current Vahumana Sage (Act IX). Version inferred.

items.name: Barbeloth
items.notes: Astromancer Barbeloth Trismegistus, Hexenzirkel 'B' (Seer-Witch) and Mona's teacher. Alive.

items.name: Bennu
items.notes: Intelligent construct made by King Deshret to guard the gates of Aaru (Acts IX-X).

items.name: Biram
items.notes: Current chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind (Mictlan). Version not verified.

items.name: Birgitta
items.notes: Aino's Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit that accompanies Ineffa; appears in Ineffa's skill.

items.name: Changsheng
items.notes: Baizhu's white snake, formerly an adeptus of Mt. Yaojun. Likely the 'Herblord' referenced in Chenyu lore (not verified; no 'Herblord' page found).

items.name: Chlothar
items.notes: Chlothar Alberich, founder of the Abyss Order, father of Caribert. Wiki marks 'deceased = Past' ambiguously; consider historical.

items.name: Chugunov
items.notes: Boss of the Iskra Manufacturing Plant and wealthy merchant. Lost his daughter Iskra to Frostblight; shut the plant down after Wraith's Nocturne.

items.name: Crepus
items.notes: Crepus Ragnvindr, late father of Diluc and adoptive father of Kaeya, killed about 4 years before the story. Recently deceased (not ancient), so filed as npc.

items.name: Cusco
items.notes: Chasca's adoptive human father (Flower-Feather Clan). Appears in the web event The Meaning of Flight and in Chasca's quests.

items.name: Edwin Eastinghouse
items.notes: Former senior researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute; key NPC in the Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles.

items.name: Efim Snezhevich
items.notes: House of the Hearth 'Teacher' among the Fatui operatives in Inazuma.

items.name: Ekaterina
items.notes: Fatui receptionist at the Northland Bank, Liyue; Childe's subordinate. | Northland Bank receptionist in Liyue Harbor; Childe's subordinate.

items.name: Enjou
items.notes: Pyro Abyss Lector; aliases Sanka, Kokuchuu, Hayne; Enkanomiya and Natlan.

items.name: Eroch
items.notes: Former Inspector of the Knights; colluded with the Fatui/Dottore and caused Diluc's departure. Unsealed Ursa. Deceased.

items.name: Euphrosiniya
items.notes: Euphrosiniya Ignatyevna Trubetskaya, Veche councillor (Trubetskoy family, linked to Nod-Krai's governors).

items.name: Ferigees
items.notes: Last Jinn mother, Guardian of the Eternal Oasis (Dirge of Bilqis).

items.name: Firnas
items.notes: Current Kshahrewar Sage (Act IX). Wiki category: Luna VII (6.6).

items.name: Frederica Gunnhildr
items.notes: The Alder Knight, mother of Jean and Barbara, and a Knights captain (mentioned).

items.name: Fujin
items.notes: Chenyu Vale adeptus (4.4 world quests).

items.name: Gediminas
items.notes: Arlecchino's subordinate in Nod-Krai.

items.name: Guoba
items.notes: Xiangling's companion and the remnant of Marchosius, God of the Stove (the wiki redirects 'Marchosius' to Guoba). Use for both identities.

items.name: Haden
items.notes: 'Wyrdsword of Heaven's End', taught Black Serpent Bladework to Dainsleif and Surtalogi; Abyss Order Iniquitous Baptist defeated in Cinder City.

items.name: Halfdan
items.notes: Royal Guard elite turned Black Serpent Knight: Windcutter; protected hilichurls in The Chasm.

items.name: Hanachirusato
items.notes: Kitsune spirit shrine maiden in the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. Bound to the Kitsune Saiguu lore.

items.name: Hiiragi Shinsuke
items.notes: Kanjou Commissioner and head of the Hiiragi Clan, involved with the Fatui. Appears in Ritou Escape Plan. Father of Hiiragi Chisato.

items.name: Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk
items.notes: Mirror of the Dawning Morn, Eleventh Sovereign Lord. Antagonist in Searing (5.8, Nod-Krai prelude); died fighting the Traveler and Ineffa.

items.name: Jakob Ingold
items.notes: Born Jakob Baker. Co-founder of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo and a 500-year-old 'neohuman' adapted to Abyssal power. Killed in Search in the Algae Sea (4.2). Wiki page title is 'Jakob'. Exact first-appearance version not verified.

items.name: Jebrael
items.notes: Jeht's father, an Eremite in the Golden Slumber series. Appears in Act IX.

items.name: Jotautas
items.notes: Oprichnik who served Columbina, then Dottore; met at Dottore's Nod-Krai facility.

items.name: Katarina
items.notes: Fatui orphan from the House of the Hearth stationed in The Chasm ('Lost in a Foreign Land'). Several Katarina NPCs exist (Fatui at banks), so disambiguate.

items.name: Katheryne
items.notes: Adventurers' Guild receptionist in every nation; one of the Tsaritsa's automatons. Not checked against the wiki in this pass; may belong to the Snezhnaya/Fatui scope.

items.name: Klingsor
items.notes: Ex-Skeptic Abyss Herald; antagonist of Khvarena of Good and Evil.

items.name: Koshchei
items.notes: 'The Deathless'; Hvergelmir bio-alchemist who created the Aberrant Chimeric Monsters, Zhara and Zver. 7.0 world quests.

items.name: Kusayla
items.notes: Leader of Dakan Al-Ahmar and Dehya's adoptive father (Dehya's story quest). Not a Sage.

items.name: Lingyuan
items.notes: Chenyu Vale adeptus and former servant of the Mistress of Chenyu Vale (4.4).

items.name: Lumi
items.notes: Linnea's Jack Frost companion; appears in her kit.

items.name: Luonnotar
items.notes: Rare rabbit-like kuuhenki born from the Moon Goddesses' blessings; linked to Columbina. Could be creature.supernatural-beings instead.

items.name: Lyudmila
items.notes: Fatui diplomat in Mondstadt; her and Mikhail's evolving dialogue gives Harbinger status updates (vacant seats, Capitano's retained seat).

items.name: Lyudochka Snezhevna
items.notes: House of the Hearth spy posing as Gendou Ringo at the Grand Narukami Shrine.

items.name: Mary-Ann
items.notes: Hybrid Oceanid formed from Lyris and Mary-Ann Guillotin. Appears in the Narzissenkreuz world quests (Mary-Ann's Story, 4.0).

items.name: Melanta
items.notes: Watcher of Melancholy, Temple of Space.

items.name: Melus
items.notes: Spina di Rosula retainer to Navia. Dissolved in Deluge of Wrathful Waters (4.2).

items.name: Mikhail
items.notes: Fatui diplomat paired with Lyudmila in Mondstadt.

items.name: Mutota
items.notes: Current chief of the Flower-Feather Clan (Tlalocan). Version not verified (open-world chief).

items.name: Nihilita
items.notes: Watcher of Nothingness, created by Asmoday for the Temple of Space; abandoned his post.

items.name: Pacal
items.notes: Current chief of the Children of Echoes.

items.name: Pavlina
items.notes: Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka (House of Hesperides) and former Hvergelmir researcher. Killed in Bell Ringing at Dusk (7.0).

items.name: Ptashka
items.notes: Ghost of a girl who died of Frostblight at the Korolevskiy Theater; posed as 'Tonia' in Wraith's Nocturne.

items.name: Pulonia
items.notes: Automaton attendant of Sandrone, built by Alain Guillotin; the wiki lists her region as Snezhnaya. Body destroyed by Il Dottore in Descending Moon. Also appears in A Winter Night's Lazzo. May be covered by the Fatui/Snezhnaya scope; dedupe. | Sandrone's companion automaton and Alain Guillotin's last creation. Its body was destroyed by Dottore in Descending Moon.

items.name: Rana
items.notes: Forest Watcher from Vimara Village (Aranyaka series). Appears in Act X.

items.name: Raskolnikov
items.notes: Fatui Poruchik overseeing the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau; also a Local Legend. Version inferred.

items.name: Rushd
items.notes: Current Haravatat Sage (Act IX). Version inferred.

items.name: Ruu
items.notes: Ghost boy at the centre of the Tsurumi Island 'Through the Mists' series. Linked to Kapatcir and the Thunderbird civilization.

items.name: Sarin
items.notes: Adventurers' Guild branch master in Nod-Krai.

items.name: Schubert
items.notes: Schubert Lawrence, Eula's haughty uncle; appears in Eula's Story Quest.

items.name: Sedene
items.notes: Melusine Marechaussee Phantom officer at the Palais Mermonia desk; a recurring Melusine face in the Archon Quest.

items.name: Serpent of All Evils
items.notes: Formerly Raimo, a human official under the Belyi Tsar turned Abyssal; Nod-Krai world quests.

items.name: Shakir
items.notes: Current Rtawahist Sage and Layla's former master. Appears in As All Falls to Emptiness. Version inferred from that quest; the page has no version category.

items.name: Shesepankh
items.notes: Deshret's construct that oversaw all Jinn (Acts IX-X).

items.name: Sigurd
items.notes: Former Lightkeeper Starshyna who died within the last decade; source of the Long Night's Oath artifact set; a Local Legend.

items.name: Silver
items.notes: Navia's Spina di Rosula butler. Dissolved in Deluge of Wrathful Waters (4.2).

items.name: Skofnungr
items.notes: Khaenri'ahn noble, Surtalogi's childhood friend ('Blood Serpent's Broken Edge').

items.name: Sobek
items.notes: Crocodile King, one of the Seven Pillars (Acts IX-X).

items.name: Sorush
items.notes: Pari Bloomguard and companion in the 3.6 Archon interlude. Also a gadget. Appears again in 6.6.

items.name: Tarno
items.notes: Voynich Guild outlet manager; Voynich representative in the League after the Nod-Krai crisis.

items.name: Tea Master Liu Su
items.notes: Storyteller at Heyu Tea House; source of Liyue legends (Shattered Halberd, etc.).

items.name: Teppei
items.notes: Watatsumi Army captain and Yoimiya's friend. Died from Delusion use in the Archon Quest. Wiki lists 2.0, but he matters in the 2.1 story.

items.name: Teucer
items.notes: Tartaglia's youngest brother; visited Liyue.

items.name: Theodore
items.notes: 8th Company trainee medic, kidnapped as a child with Lohen by Eroch; appears in 'A Knight's Legacy'.

items.name: Tonia
items.notes: Tartaglia's younger sister. Open-world NPC after Wraith's Nocturne (7.0); long mentioned before. Do not confuse with Ptashka, who posed as 'Tonia'.

items.name: Tugarin
items.notes: Alyosha's hunting dog; appears in his Elemental Burst.

items.name: Ultimate Calamity
items.notes: Formerly R.M. Morozov, Supervisor of the 'Post-Apocalyptic Elysium'; Abyssal; Nod-Krai world quests.

items.name: Uncle Tian
items.notes: The Tianshu of the Liyue Qixing (secretly); father of Huixin.

items.name: Velimiru
items.notes: Artificial Fatuus made by Sandrone who led the Fajeyi/Gulebu special-ops team in Natlan; killed. Version inferred.

items.name: Vilemina
items.notes: Lauma's childhood friend, a disillusioned Frostmoon Scion who secretly tried to join the Fatui.

items.name: Wayna
items.notes: Current chief of the Scions of the Canopy (Huitztlan).

items.name: Ying'er
items.notes: Liyue Harbor socialite and cosmetics seller; dialogue tied to the Liyue Archon Quest.

items.name: Zmei
items.notes: Zmei Luchkin, leader of the Luchkin gang and current Speaker of a body; the intro was truncated, so verify which.

items.name: Adorno
items.notes: The Benevolent Knight, former Captain of the 5th Company, deceased; quest-exclusive.

items.name: Allpa
items.notes: Flower-Feather elder who gave the infant Chasca to Cusco; mother of Tepal. Of Fading Flowers and Falling Feathers (5.2).

items.name: Andrei
items.notes: Manager of the Northland Bank in Liyue Harbor.

items.name: Antei
items.notes: Antigone, the Enkanomiya 'Transgressor' from the Three Realms Gateway Offering storyline.

items.name: Anthon
items.notes: Tartaglia's younger brother; mentioned only.

items.name: Apepi
items.notes: Shimti tribe figure in the Nod-Krai Archon Quest 'Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion' (Nefer). Not the dragon Apep.

items.name: Ashru
